name: step-code
label: Step Code
description: StepFun's terminal coding agent for Step models, driven headless
tagline: StepFun's terminal coding agent, on a Step Plan sign-in or a Step Platform API key. Installed by StepFun's own script.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not signed in, or the sign-in has expired — run `step login` in a terminal (Step Plan, mainland China or international), or set a Step Platform API key (press e): https://platform.stepfun.com/interface-key, or platform.stepfun.ai for an international account.

env_config.name: STEP_API_KEY
env_config.description: Step Platform API key — leave blank to use the account signed in with `step login` on this machine. Create one at https://platform.stepfun.com/interface-key (mainland China) or https://platform.stepfun.ai/interface-key (international); a key set here always takes precedence over that sign-in.

env_config.name: STEP_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Base URL for the API key above, prefilled with the mainland China Step Platform. International keys: https://api.stepfun.ai/v1. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint that serves /v1/models works too. Not used with a `step login` sign-in, whose region comes from the sign-in.

env_config.name: STEP_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id, e.g. step-3.5-flash. Leave blank for Step Code's default; the list is loaded from the endpoint (or from the sign-in).
